parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger
Runs every Monday at 08:00 (Asia/Calcutta). No manual action needed.

## 2. Read Data
Reads ALL rows from the 'sales_data' sheet (date, product_name, category, units_sold, revenue).

## 3. Calculate
This week vs last week metrics: revenue, orders, AOV, WoW change, top 3 products, declining product.

## 4. AI Insights
Build prompt → OpenAI gpt-4o-mini → safe JSON parse with fallback (never breaks the run).

## 5. Email + Slack
Build HTML report, email the founder, and post a plain-text summary to Slack. All continue-on-fail.

## 6. Log
Append one audit row to the 'report_log' sheet, including email_status (Sent/Failed).
